content: CQF/Squeakr (Bioinformatics 2018): cache-friendly quotient filter, insert/delete/count/resize/merge/concurrent. Exact mode=invertible hash+enlarged remainder (no FP); approx=MurmurHash+small remainder. Squeakr 2-4.3x faster, 1.5-4.3x leaner than KMC2/Jellyfish2 on count+query; per-thread local CQFs merged. Rust: qfilter (RSQF, approximate fingerprint, needs popcnt, NOT exact-u32), COMBINE-lab/cqf-rust (C++ wrapper exact, libssl/MSRV/wheel risk), mqf (stale C++ 2019). No pure-Rust exact-u32 CQF off-the-shelf. DEFER behind partitioning (VERY HIGH complexity, conflicts exact-u32+MSRV1.80+pure-Rust PyO3).
